title: Predicting Surface Displacement Fields of Laser Powder Bed Fusion Parts Using STL-Derived Graphs and Part-Level Descriptors
abstract: arXiv:2611.26323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting part distortion before fabrication remains challenging in laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), while thermomechanical simulation is computationally expensive for repeated design evaluations. This study presents a two-branch graph attention network (GAT) to predict three-dimensional surface displacement directly from STL-derived graphs. The first branch learns geometric relationships among connected vertices of a densified STL surface mesh, while the second incorporates 12 part-level descriptors of mass distribution, build-plate contact, overhang, size, and shape. Displacement labels from ANSYS Additive Print simulations are mapped onto STL vertices using Gaussian-kernel weighted averaging. Evaluated on 117 parts using five-fold cross-validation split by part, the model achieves an R^2 of 0.946 and a mean absolute error of 0.0178 mm for displacement magnitude. Relative to a node-wise multilayer perceptron, GAT improves R^2 from 0.91

translated_title: 基于STL衍生图与零件级描述符的激光粉末床熔融零件表面位移场预测
translated_abstract: 在激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）中，制造前预测零件变形仍然具有挑战性，而热力学模拟在重复设计评估中计算成本高昂。本研究提出了一种双分支图注意力网络（GAT），直接从STL衍生的图中预测三维表面位移。第一分支学习加密后的STL表面网格中连接顶点之间的几何关系，第二分支则融入了12个关于质量分布、基板接触、悬垂结构、尺寸和形状的零件级描述符。来自ANSYS Additive Print模拟的位移标签通过高斯核加权平均映射到STL顶点上。在117个零件上按零件划分进行五折交叉验证评估，该模型在位移幅值预测上达到0.946的R²和0.0178 mm的平均绝对误差。与逐节点多层感知机相比，GAT将R²从0.91提升至更高水平。
tldr: 该研究提出一种双分支图注意力网络，直接从STL衍生图结合零件级描述符预测激光粉末床熔融零件的三维表面位移场，R²达0.946、平均绝对误差仅0.0178毫米，为替代计算昂贵的热力学模拟提供了高效的零件变形预测方案。
en_tdlr: A two-branch graph attention network that directly predicts 3D surface displacement fields of LPBF parts from STL-derived graphs combined with part-level descriptors, achieving an R² of 0.946 and MAE of 0.0178 mm, offering an efficient alternative to computationally expensive thermomechanical simulation for part distortion prediction.
